title: Critically Engaged Pragmatism: A Scientific Norm and Social, Pragmatist Epistemology for AI Science Evaluation Tools
reasoning: The paper is a philosophical exploration of social epistemology and scientific norms. It proposes a new scientific norm ('Critically Engaged Pragmatism') to address the ethical and epistemic challenges of using AI for scientific evaluation, focusing on the legitimacy of these tools and their potential social and epistemic harms.
